name: Hjarni notes
description:
Hjarni is a knowledge base your AI can actually use.

Write notes in Markdown. Organize them in folders and tags. Claude reads them directly through a built-in MCP server. No plugins. No pasting the same context into every conversation.

Claude starts every conversation from zero. Connect Hjarni once and it stops asking. Ask questions across all your notes. Have Claude write new notes, update old ones, and tag them the way you want.

Set instructions per folder to control how Claude writes, formats, and tags. Share a folder with your team so everyone's AI works from the same knowledge base. Search across everything in one call.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hjarni notes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hjarni notes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://hjarni.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hjarni notes MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hjarni notes lists 34 MCP tools, including containers-create, containers-get, containers-list, containers-permissions, containers-update, dashboard-get, feedback-submit, files-attach, files-attach_from_url, files-check_upload, files-create_upload_url, and files-get_download_url.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hjarni notes?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hjarni notes in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Hjarni notes MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hjarni notes requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hjarni notes is developed by Hjarni. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
